title: How Many Pairs Have LCM 72? | AMC 8-Style Level 5
description:
Two numbers have a least common multiple of 72, and order matters. How many pairs are there? Vantee counts them with a table of partners, then again one prime at a time with two small grids, explains why each wrong answer is tempting, and gives you LCM 48 to try yourself.
